crossRefs.note: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was…
Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of…
Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,
The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for…
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into…
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into Yahweh’s house.
